analysis:
The only changed file is CHANGELOG.md, which is documentation. The head text adds a v0.10.1 candidate section (lines 11-96) above the existing v0.10.0 notes; the old v0.10.0 'candidate' heading was replaced by a published v0.10.0 entry at line 98-100. No executable code, configuration, key handling or protocol logic changes in this diff, so I found no concrete regression. Statements in the notes that describe behaviour changes, and therefore need review in the source PRs and not in this one:

1. Line 45: a verified-weights record at ~/.darkbloom/verified-weights.json lets a start skip rehashing GLM weights while device, inode, size, mtime and ctime are unchanged. This is relevant to T-012, T-027 and A-004 (weight substitution). The metadata-only fast path is weaker than a full rehash, because an operator with a same-inode write that preserves the timestamps could bypass it. ctime cannot be set by user-space, which mitigates that, but the implementation is not visible here. Line 44 states that the managed load still verifies every file against the catalog manifest, so the fast path applies only to registration. The code needs review.

2. Lines 26-36: GLM now accepts strict tools, JSON mode and forced tool choice, with output validation (withholding until the schema matches, 422 on failure). This relates to T-007 and T-008 (fail-closed handling). The implementation is not in the supplied evidence.

3. Lines 69-73: page-cache accounting counts more memory as available, and the weight-hashing path drops cached pages. This affects T-016 and T-029 (availability and memory admission).

4. Line 56: the Nemotron media body bound rises from 8 MiB to 40 MiB. This raises DoS and memory exposure on the provider and relates to T-010, so the reservation checks need review.

5. Line 22: the macOS 27 installer requirement. Lines 90-96 and the line 88 console link-purpose change are release/console items that fall outside the provider scope.

The T-041 prefix-cache posture is not changed by the notes. No change to TTL, scope or key derivation is stated.

No changed source is visible here. Coverage is limited to the changelog prose, and the claims need verification against the corresponding source diffs.
